notes.title: FULL VERSION
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Everyone![/h1]

The Desktop Mars is finally ready to leave the Early Access stage.

The game has been improved and upgraded with new buildings to create more amazing Mars colonies.

[h1]Improvements:[/h1]

Optimization to reduce PC usage.

Many new buildings.

The new mining drone system.

Improved menu.

Fixed minor bugs.

The new DUST STORMS system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41898333/13f647d98da7185ac4debd258f3e83478ab21e8a.jpg[/img]

[h2]One of the biggest problems on Mars is the dust. We had to add this part to the game.[/h2]

The dust in game will reduce the productivity of the dirty building. You will have to clean the building to keep productivity at a high level. The cleaning is on a single button. You don't have to click and click on the dirty building.

The new DUST STORM can also fully destroy some of the buildings.  


----------------------------------------------------------------------------


[h2]I would like to thank everyone for their support, interesting ideas and constructive feedback. Thanks to you, this game is much better. Thank you![/h2]

Please let me know with any problems. I will fix it ASAP! :D

[h2]Best Regards,[/h2]
3DM Greg
